_why: How this archive decides who is living and who is held out, as David ruled on 16 October 2026 (standard v2). The test itself is the kit's: kit/tools/living_rule.py, through tools/livingset.py. Written by tools/build_site_data.py on every full run. It records the RULE AND COUNTS; it never records a person: no id, no name, no place, no date.
tools/livingcheck.py recomputes who is living from the tree with the kit's rule, independently of the generator, and refuses the build when this file disagrees.

rules.rule: Born 80 years ago or less by year (this year minus the birth year), with no death RECORD. A citation from a public record source does NOT release somebody who has a birth year, and a bare death flag (a death event that is only Y: no date, no place, no burial) is not a record for them either: the kit's rule since 341af33. A source can show that a person was born or arrived, never that they have died. The window's edge is one derived constant, livingset.cutoff_year().
A person in the window whose only death is a death with a place and no date, named in data/living-hold.tsv, is held as living until the death is confirmed.

A dated death or burial in the tree, a death with a place, cause or note, or a death read in sources/documented.psv, or a grave photograph tagged with them, or a surveyed stone with their name, birth year and a death year, means dead. A bare death flag means dead only for somebody with no birth year or born before the window.
Nobody with no birth year is living: it cannot be shown that they are 80 or younger.
An undated person (no birth year) with a living parent, not recorded dead and with no public source, is held out: no page, no name as anyone's relative.

A POSSIBLE MINOR is held out and published nowhere: no page, no name page, no name as anyone's relative, no photograph, no entry in any list or index. A possible minor is somebody with no death record who is born this year minus 18 or later, or is undated with a parent born in 1975 or later (David, 25 October 2026; it replaces the 16 October rule that a child with a known birth year follows the ordinary living standard). The kit's living_rule.py does not hold them out (KIT GAP): tools/livingset.py minor_ids() computes them and passes them to the kit's is_held_out as held_ids. They remain living.
Every person the archive names (a relative on a published page, or tagged on a published photograph) has a person page. Not recursive.
